text: EVACUATION ORDER: Eaton Fire. Immediate evacuation ordered for Pasadena, San Pasqual, Altadena, and Sierra Madre. Leave now. Pasadena: leave via State Rte 134 (W). San Pasqual: leave via State Rte 19 (SE). Altadena: leave via I-210 (W). Sierra Madre: leave now and follow directions from emergency personnel.
